applies_to.selection: the version the capture discovered with junie --version

executor: journal-ocsf-writer JunieStdoutMapper (direct Java); one record at a time
identity: junie.stdout.identity.v1: the session record's sessionId; steps carry no id
usage: junie.stdout.error_code_usage.v1: the result's errorCode member is a list of per-model usage entries (model, calls, cost, token counts), not an error; junie.usage.unnamed_cost.v1: a usage entry's cost is a quantity whose unit the source does not name (kind 99 Other, no currency); the per-model costs of the recorded runs sum to completion.taskCostUsd, but a sum in one run does not name their unit

rules.owner: one text block from result; no id
per-model usage (scope 6, final, cumulative) and unnamed-unit cost (kind 99, model_ref) from errorCode[]
retained whole: a step without an id is never joined or counted as an operation

rules.selector: a record that is not one JSON object

rules.owner: the record retained whole with the failure
